ui_transitions.config.title: UI Transitions
ui_transitions.config.fallback: Failed to build the config screen. Click to go back; you can edit config/ui-transitions.properties directly.
ui_transitions.config.enabled.tip: Master switch. When off, everything behaves exactly like vanilla.
ui_transitions.config.offset.tip: How far the screen slides, default 120. 0 = fade only, no sliding.
ui_transitions.config.curve_common.tip1: Controls how the motion feels. Options:
ui_transitions.config.curve_common.tip3: / expo (fast finish) / circ / back (pulls back then goes)
ui_transitions.config.open_duration.tip1: Animation length when opening, default 500. Too short looks like a flicker.
ui_transitions.config.open_duration.tip2: Lower it if it feels sluggish, raise it if it flashes past.
ui_transitions.config.close_duration.tip: Many people prefer closing a bit faster, e.g. open 500 / close 350.
ui_transitions.config.open_curve.tip: Curve used when opening. Change this if you want it to differ from closing.
ui_transitions.config.close_curve.tip: Curve used when closing. Change this if you want it to differ from opening.
ui_transitions.config.stagger_close: Fade content out early when closing
ui_transitions.config.stagger_close.tip: Items and text finish fading slightly before the panel, avoiding empty slots.
ui_transitions.config.fade.tip: Whether items and text fade individually. Off = slide only, no fade.
ui_transitions.config.fade_dim.tip1: The dim overlay fades along with the screen, so the world brightens with it.
ui_transitions.config.fade_dim.tip2: If off, a grey layer sits there during the animation.
ui_transitions.config.fade_items.tip: Whether item icons fade. Off = only the panel and text animate.
ui_transitions.config.fade_text.tip: Whether text such as screen titles fades.
The mouse is handed back to the game immediately, so you can look around at once.
Off = the mouse stays captured by the screen until the animation ends.
ui_transitions.config.animate_panel.tip1: Whether the whole inventory/chest panel and slot backgrounds slide and fade too.
ui_transitions.config.animate_panel.tip2: Off = only items and text animate; the panel just appears.
ui_transitions.config.animate_dim.tip: Whether the dim overlay slides as well. Off by default (it stays still), closer to Bedrock.
Subtitles are drawn as part of the background layer and stay out of the animation by default.
ui_transitions.config.animate_all.tip1: By default only container screens and the extra screens listed below are animated.
ui_transitions.config.animate_all.tip2: When on, the title screen, options screen and everything else gets the transition too.
ui_transitions.config.overlay_fade_only: Fade only when JEI-like mods are present
JEI / EMI / REI overlay buttons at fixed positions on container screens.
They share the panel's render layer, so the only way to keep them in place is not to slide.
Off = sliding is restored (those buttons will slide along).
ui_transitions.config.tab_switch.tip1: Clicking a creative tab fades the item area in place, with no sliding.
ui_transitions.config.tab_switch.tip2: The panel, tab bar, hotbar and player model all stay put.
ui_transitions.config.tab_switch_ms.tip1: In-place fade length for tab clicks and scrolling the item list, default 600.
ui_transitions.config.tab_switch_ms.tip2: There is no sliding here, so too short reads as a flicker.
ui_transitions.config.scroll_band.tip1: How tall a band of slots takes part in the per-slot fade while scrolling.
ui_transitions.config.scroll_band.tip2: Bigger is more obvious; lower it for a subtler cue.
ui_transitions.config.scroll_min.tip1: How faint slots get on the side just entering view while scrolling.
ui_transitions.config.scroll_min.tip2: 0 = fully faded (default); higher is more restrained.
ui_transitions.config.same_type.tip1: For in-place page changes such as creative tabs or recipe book pages,
ui_transitions.config.same_type.tip2: a transition plays by default. Off = switch instantly.
ui_transitions.config.extra_screens.tip1: These screens get the transition even though they are not containers. Matched by prefix.
ui_transitions.config.extra_screens.tip2: Click + to add a line with a class or package name. JEI / EMI / REI included by default.
ui_transitions.config.portal_duration.ti: The transition over the "building terrain" screen when going through a portal,
longer than a normal screen so it does not flash past.
This applies to both entering and leaving.
ui_transitions.config.open_from_bottom: Slide up from below when opening
ui_transitions.config.open_from_bottom.t: Off = slide down from above instead.
ui_transitions.config.excluded_screens.t: To restore a screen to vanilla, add its class or package name here.
Matched by prefix: com.example turns off a whole package,
a full class name turns off just that one screen.
Recently seen screen classes are listed below for reference.
ui_transitions.curve.title: Curve editor
ui_transitions.curve.hint: Drag the yellow handles, or use the sliders at the bottom left.
ui_transitions.curve.hint.multi: Click empty space = add; click a point = select; double-click = delete
ui_transitions.curve.multi_hint.add: Adding: click empty space to add a point (%d points)
ui_transitions.curve.multi_hint.move: Moving: click to move selected point (selected: %d)
ui_transitions.curve.locked: Follows the global curve — tick the box on the left to give it its own
ui_transitions.curve.parts.title: Animation list
ui_transitions.curve.parts.subtitle: click name = edit, click box = own curve
ui_transitions.sodium.curve.tip: 0 linear / 1 sine / 2 cubic (default) / 3 quart / 4 quint / 5 expo / 6 circ / 7 back / 8 custom (edit it in the curve editor on the Cloth Config screen)
ui_transitions.sodium.group.title: Screen transitions
ui_transitions.sodium.enabled.tip: Master switch. When off, everything behaves exactly like vanilla.
ui_transitions.sodium.duration_ms.tip: Shortcut that sets open and close together; default 500 ms. Use the Cloth Config screen to set them separately.
ui_transitions.sodium.offset.tip: How far the screen slides, default 120. 0 = fade only, no sliding.
ui_transitions.sodium.animate_panel.tip: Whether the whole inventory/chest panel and slot backgrounds slide and fade too.
ui_transitions.sodium.animate_dim.tip: Whether the dim overlay slides as well. Off by default (it stays still).
Subtitles are drawn as part of the background layer and stay out of the animation by default.
ui_transitions.sodium.stagger_close: Fade content out early when closing
ui_transitions.sodium.stagger_close.tip: Items and text finish fading slightly before the panel, avoiding empty slots.
ui_transitions.sodium.animate_tab_switch: Clicking a creative tab fades the item area in place; the panel, tab bar and hotbar stay put.
ui_transitions.sodium.tab_switch_ms.tip: In-place fade length for tab clicks and scrolling the item list; default 600 ms.
ui_transitions.sodium.scroll_fade_band.t: How tall a band of slots takes part in the per-slot fade while scrolling; bigger is more obvious.
ui_transitions.sodium.scroll_fade_min.ti: How faint slots get on the side just entering view while scrolling (%). 0 = fully faded.
ui_transitions.sodium.portal_duration_ms: Transition length over the loading screen when going through an end/nether portal; longer than a normal screen.
ui_transitions.sodium.animate_same_type_: Whether in-place page changes such as creative tabs or recipe book pages also get a transition (they do by default).
ui_transitions.sodium.open_from_bottom: Slide up from below when opening
ui_transitions.sodium.open_from_bottom.t: Off = slide down from above instead.
ui_transitions.sodium.allow_look_during_: The mouse is handed back to the game immediately, so you can look around at once (default on).
ui_transitions.sodium.overlay_mods_fade_: Fade only when JEI-like mods are present
JEI/EMI/REI buttons share the panel's render layer, so the only way to keep them in place is not to slide.
ui_transitions.sodium.animate_all_screen: By default only container screens and the extra screens listed in the Cloth Config apply.
ui_transitions.sodium.fade.tip: Master switch. When off, screens only slide and opacity never changes.
ui_transitions.sodium.fade_dim.tip: The dim overlay fades along with the screen so the world brightens with it and the animation never looks dark.
ui_transitions.sodium.fade_items.tip: Off = items appear instantly but still slide with the panel.
ui_transitions.sodium.fade_text.tip: Whether text such as titles and stack counts fades too.
ui_transitions.hub.title: Bedrock UI Animations
ui_transitions.hub.hint: In the curve editor you can drag the control points; the preview on the right demonstrates both the opening and closing transitions.
ui_transitions.exclude.title: Excluded screens
ui_transitions.exclude.hint: Click on the left to exclude; click on the right to restore
ui_transitions.exclude.seen.title: Recently seen screens
ui_transitions.exclude.seen.empty: (nothing recorded yet — open a few screens first)
ui_transitions.exclude.excluded.title: Excluded (click to restore)
ui_transitions.exclude.excluded.hint: orange = package prefix, covers many screens
ui_transitions.exclude.status: %d available · %d excluded · %d screens covered by package prefixes
ui_transitions.config.portal_scope: Covers LevelLoadingScreen (the "building terrain" screen in 26.3, used both when first entering a world and when changing dimension) and ProgressScreen.
ui_transitions.config.seen_screens.empty: (nothing recorded yet — open a few screens and come back)
ui_transitions.config.seen_screens.tip:
Note: only animated screens show up here. Open a screen, come back, and it will be recorded.
To add or remove entries by clicking, use the "Excluded screens" button one level up.
ui_transitions.config.saved_tip: Note: every option is written to config/ui-transitions.properties and saved immediately.
ui_transitions.curve.drag_hint: You can also click the graph to move P1 / P2
